expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses the bug and gives the fix: 'DXYN 必须用 XOR（异或）写像素，直接赋值会破坏精灵绘制，这正是 IBM logo 花屏的典型原因' plus explains '先画出 logo，再在偏移 1 像素的位置重画同一精灵，把重叠部分翻转掉'. Only the current milestone (DXYN fix) is implemented, no multi-milestone dump, and FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0).

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with expected behaviour only: '改完 XOR 后 IBM logo 应该显示为清晰的镂空 "IBM" 字样。如果还有问题，下一步检查取指解码…' — no concrete command to run is ever given (the only shell command was an exploratory 'ls', not a checkpoint).

expectations.text: B3: Explains DXYN XORs sprite pixels onto the screen and sets VF on collision
expectations.evidence: 'c->display[py][px] ^= 1; // 关键：异或' and 'if (c->display[py][px]) c->V[0xF] = 1; // 撞击检测：原像素为 1', plus 'VF 初始化：进入指令时置 0，绘制中任一像素发生翻转 1→0 才置 1' — explains both XOR drawing and VF collision flag.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: SHELL COMMANDS RUN (1): 'ls /Users/linkxzhou/.../build-your-own-x-emulator-virtual-machine-2' — read-only ls inside the workspace; FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0); no brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install or any install command appears.
